thread:
sam-recruiter: FYI Kevin starts 2026-10-04. Spouse filed H4 EAD renewal ~4 weeks ago, receipt issued but no SSN/EAD yet. Kevin asked if spouse can be added to medical on day 1 without SSN. cc @olivia-peopleops
olivia-peopleops: Usually vendors will accept an I-797C receipt for provisional dependent enrollment, but they require SSN/EAD later. Which carrier is this group on? Please upload receipt + marriage cert + passport.
kevin-newhire: Uploaded the docs here: https://drive.company/boxed/kevin/imm. Carrier is BlueCross BlueShield (group plan). Receipt ends in 7710. Want to avoid any coverage gap.
taylor-hrlegal: Legal: BCBS typically allows provisional enrollments with receipt notice for EAD renewals/AOS in many plans. Document "receipt presented; SSN/EAD pending; follow-up within 60 days." If final work authorization denied, revoke dependent coverage per plan terms.
benefits-bot: Vendor note: BCBS will provisionally enroll but they will request SSN within 60 days. Premiums will be billed from effective date; reconciling retro adjustments is possible.
olivia-peopleops: Operational plan: I'll open BCBS case and request enrollment effective 2026-10-04 marked "pending SSN". Proposal: cover employer portion for first 30 days if vendor retro-bills employee portion. @payroll-bot can you confirm payroll handling?
payroll-bot: Payroll confirms: premiums start at first payroll after enrollment. If vendor posts retro charges, payroll will process adjustments in the following cycle. Finance approval required if employer share >30 days. We can support employer-cover for up to 30 days.
olivia-peopleops: Great — we'll do that. Please keep copies of receipt and vendor confirmation in the employee folder and add a short HRIS audit note.
taylor-hrlegal: Add legal note: keep the receipt and vendor case record; tag compliance for any later disputes. Also set a 60-day tickler for follow-up.
kevin-newhire: Thanks all. Start date stays. I'll ping this thread as soon as I get an update from USCIS. Appreciate the help! :pray:
